message: 全てを乗り越えて

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「...So you have appeared after all.」
Within the crystal-clear space brimming with Spirit Power...
Azel already dominated the entire area as the solemn incarnation of Re-Crea.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」

name: Melilot
message: 「The power of Re-Crea... I shall sever it right here and now.」

name: Azel
message: 「It is futile.」

name: Azel
message: 「Your struggles are as good as powerless before my master's will.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I think it's worth a shot, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「Never learning your lesson...」

name: Bylous
message: 「Normally, I wouldn't bother with anything other than a one-on-one fight, but...」

name: Bylous
message: 「I owe the Demon Lord and the Witch a favor from the Demon World.」

name: Bylous
message: 「More than anything, I still haven't traded blows with either a Demon Lord or a God.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Because I can't let that opportunity be taken from me here.」

name: Azel
message: 「How foolish...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. We're going to stop you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whether it's God's will or whatever else, we won't let you destroy this world!」

name: Melilot
message: 「If God wishes to test us, then we shall gladly accept.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The power of human will and bonds... We will make you reconsider your view of them!」

name: Azel
message: 「No matter what you say...」

name: Azel
message: 「There is nothing I believe in other than the will of the Lord!」

name: Azel
message: 「Learn firsthand which of us is truly in the right!」
